critical_code_review_comments: MEDIUM: SEOHead in FinancialIndependenceScore.jsx is inside 'if (completed)' block at line 176. Search engine bots will never see the FI Score-specific title/description. Move SEOHead above the conditional so it renders for all states. The quiz completion state only affects page content, not SEO title.

MINOR: index.html has TWO duplicate <title> tags at lines 9 and 61 (both same default text). React-helmet-async adds a 3rd dynamic one, creating 6 total title elements in DOM on calculator pages. Should remove line 61 duplicate from index.html.

MINOR: react-helmet-async adds new meta tags (description, og:description, twitter:title) instead of replacing the existing ones from index.html static HTML. Results in 2 meta[name=description] tags and 2 og:description tags per page. The page-specific one IS present and correct, but duplicates remain. This is standard react-helmet-async behavior with static HTML - to fix: remove pre-filled meta tags from index.html that will be set dynamically by react-helmet-async.
INFO: Countdown timer shows ~9 days (April 6 to April 15, 2026) not ~69 days. System actual date is April 2026, not February 2026 as stated in review. Timer is correct.
